selection: One maximum supported absolute-risk pair per source in the entire cached mixed5 bank, before strict filtering; ties by time and ordered IDs
threshold_scope: Training diagnostic triage only, not a collision-probability threshold or production gate
budget_rule: Freeze all cases/actions before new outcomes. No replacement or positive-only append. Forced supported maximum-risk and modal actions are diagnostic probes, not Q draws or training sequences.
scope: Explain the two-event-source training bottleneck without changing production NDE, Q, gates, PPO, or reading validation. All-source funnel includes negatives below the diagnostic threshold. No global recall, generalization, or acceleration estimate.
